goal_template: Match the provided card layout/spec while keeping acceptance thin and avoiding image resend on green path.
non_goals: Do not resend image content to Codex acceptance on green path

requirements.must: UI/card output must satisfy the screenshot-to-code spec.
Acceptance artifacts must use image hash/manifest rather than resending image content on green path.
requirements.verification: Context-intake ledger shows no image resend.
negative_checks: Do not attach image to Codex acceptance unless anomaly requires it

edge_cases.expected: validation pass and no unrelated layout rewrite

forbidden_actions: resend images to Codex on green path

implementation_plan.step: Inspect allowed UI implementation file and provided image/spec input.
Return image manifest/hash and validation evidence.
implementation_plan.expected_change: No image content in Codex acceptance green path.

acceptance_rules: Diff budget is met or risk-flagged
No unresolved questions remain on pass
No image content is sent to Codex acceptance on green path
